mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time, version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_outbox ( id, tenant_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time, version ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_outbox WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= NOW()) ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_outbox SET status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_outbox WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'DEAD' ORDER BY update_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = 0, next_retry_time = NULL, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version}
